items.information: Bolivia Nationals 2024, in its fifth edition, the National Rubik's Cube Championship will aim to bring together the best speedcubers in the country. This year, hosted at the Centro Boliviano-Americano in the city of Santa Cruz de la Sierra, this tournament will provide a unique venue for all competitors to showcase their skills and speed in the different categories. This competition is open to all public. To see all the information about register payment go to the next [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaNationals2024#48693-instrucciones-de-pago) **More information about the competitions enter to: [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaNationals2024#48694-faq-pmf)** Bolivia Nationals 2024, en su quinta edición, el Campeonato Nacional del Cubo de Rubik buscará reunir a los mejores speedcubers del país. Este año, con sede en el Centro Boliviano-Americano, en la ciudad de Santa Cruz de la Sierra, este torneo ofrecerá un espacio único para que todos los competidores demuestren sus habilidades y velocidad en las diferentes categorías. Esta competencia esta abierta a todo publico. Para ver la informacion acerca del pago de inscripcion entra al siguiente [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaNationals2024#48693-instrucciones-de-pago) **Mas informacion acerca de las competencias ingresar a: [Preguntas frecuentes / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaNationals2024#48694-faq-pmf)** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzY1MjAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--1fa9a61538cc5b9162c2eb65a44f76d130c3234d/BolNats%20Logo.png.jpg) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdmRoIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3fc42e8568318e4213687be53b736e207842aacd/WhatsApp%20Image%202023-12-24%20at%2010.41.18.jpeg) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzY2NDEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--50cccaf5a3f11bd4abfe575989b5af4027728181/IMG-20240909-WA0025.jpg) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzY2NDIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--7da9ad33c0043e4ce24674024486e6e4eb397fe5/IMG-20240909-WA0027.jpg) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzY1MjEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--67a3da432d47e104ce7dd9e8571ebec7d8f75a2d/Dise%C3%B1o%20sin%20t%C3%ADtulo.png)

items.information: Esta competencia, al ser de carácter nacional, busca incluir la mayor participación posible, con el objetivo de generar puestos y podios para Guatemala. This national competition, tries to include the highest possible participation, with the purpose of generating accurate rankings and podiums.
